officialText:
Section 220.14(A) – Revise Section 220.14(A) to read as follows:

(A)Specific Appliances or Loads. An outlet for a specific appliance or other load not covered in 220.14(B) through (N) shall be calculated based on the ampere rating of the appliance or load served.

Section 220.14(N) – Add a new Section 220.14(N) to read as follows:

(N)Air Conditioning Circuits. A load of not less than 1500VA shall be calculated for each required branch circuit specified in 210.52(J). It shall be permitted to be included with the appliance load specified in 220.53.
